name: paseo
description: Pimi desktop workspace for AI coding agents

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "npm run watch:protocol" "npm run watch:client" "npm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client:clean: npm run build:protocol:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/client
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names highlight,plugin,relay --prefix-colors yellow,green,blue "npm run build:highlight" "npm run build:plugin" "npm run build:relay"
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean && npm run build:relay:clean
scripts.build:server: npm run build:server-deps && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.build:server:clean: npm run build:server-deps:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.build:app-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:client && npm run build:plugin && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/builtin-plugins && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:app-deps:clean && cd packages/app && cross-env PASEO_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop --
scripts.pimi:package:mac: npm run build:server && cross-env PASEO_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npm run build:web --workspace=@getpaseo/app && npm run build:main --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop && npm exec --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.pimi.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pimi:package:win: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'win32' || process.arch !== 'x64') throw new Error('Run this command on Windows with x64 Node.js and run npm ci first.')" && npm run build:server && cross-env PASEO_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npm run build:web --workspace=@getpaseo/app && npm run build:main --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop && npm exec --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.pimi.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
